result.summary: The screen has a few visual and content inconsistencies, mainly related to filtering and text clipping.

issues.description: Category filter 'Pizza' is selected, but displayed restaurants include ramen, burgers, and poké.
issues.suggestion: Update listings to match the active filter or reset selection state.

issues.description: Text 'Trattoria Piccol' in the horizontal carousel is cut off abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis or allow two-line wrapping.

issues.description: Food items use simplified vector placeholder graphics instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace generic illustrations with real merchant imagery.
